function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values — rows may not be one-per-entity", "implication": "The data contains multiple rows per patient (due to re-testing), as indicated by `sample_seq`. The documentation states that the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient. Therefore, to compute the mean `biomarker_final` across all patients, we must deduplicate the data on `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` for each patient. Failure to do so would double-weight re-tested patients and bias the mean. This changes the analysis: we must first deduplicate before computing the mean."}
function.name: note_finding
